title: Rust 1.98 and older are no longer supported
summary: The Rust project only provides support and security updates for the most recent stable release, so a release line is unsupported once the next stable release ships. Rust 1.99 was released on 2026-10-01.

constraints: Keep the toolchain in rust-toolchain(.toml), CI (for example dtolnay/rust-toolchain or rustup), and container images on one supported release.
Check the project's MSRV (`rust-version`) separately: raising the toolchain does not require raising it.

steps.title: Raise the pinned toolchain
steps.instructions: Change the reported channel in rust-toolchain(.toml) to the latest stable release, or to `stable`, so the project follows supported releases.

steps.title: Align other toolchain surfaces
steps.instructions: Update CI toolchain setup and Dockerfile `rust:` images so they match the new release.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active toolchain is the intended release.
Build and test every target on the new toolchain.
Review the lints the newer toolchain reports.
